name: mobilefrei
description: Mobil'Efrei: shortcuts to install and run the back end and the front end together

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')){fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env');console.log('backend/.env created: fill in DB_PASSWORD and ADMIN2_PASSWORD')}" && npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create --prefix backend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,site -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
